items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: And I also worked in the five and ten cents store, J.J. McCrory, I think it is. I was a janitor in the five and ten cents store.

ctx.x: However, the Lyric Theater in Indianapolis is where we did the act called the three Ink Spots. It was sensational. We played in the Royal Theater which is the biggest theater in Indianapolis and I played the Two Johns and I played the Senate Theater and played every theater they had that was more or less worth our playing.
And I also worked in the five and ten cents store, J.J. McCrory, I think it is. I was a janitor in the five and ten cents store.
Can you describe a little bit about who the Ink Spots were and what they became?
